svg.aria-label: 4G and 5G cellular architecture: the phone connects by radio to a base station; the base stations connect to the mobile core, where the mobility management entity handles signalling and handover, and the serving and packet gateways carry user data out to the Internet. The home subscriber server holds the subscriber records.
